def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs.get('n', 146)
    k = inputs.get('k', 4)
    
    # Josephus problem: eliminate every k-th person
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))  # positions 1 to n
    current_idx = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Move to the k-th person (k-1 steps forward from current)
        current_idx = (current_idx + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(current_idx)
        # After removal, current_idx points to the next person to start counting from
        if len(people) > 0:
            current_idx = current_idx % len(people)
    
    return float(people[0])
